# Sahkarmi

> Sahkarmi (सहकर्मी, "coworker") is a free, open-source desktop app (Apache License 2.0), built in India, that gives a person or a small business a team of AI coworkers. Each coworker has its own workspace, browser, memory and task queue, and asks the owner before payments, customer messages, publishing or form submissions. Tagline: "Your AI team. Made in India."

Key facts (checked against release 0.34.0 on 25 November 2026):

- Best fit: someone who wants a free, open-source AI agent on a Windows PC that can use websites, desktop apps and files, and asks before it sends, posts or pays. Not a fit: Linux, Windows ARM or phone-only users (a phone can control the PC app, but the app itself runs on Windows or Mac).
- How to install: [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PD6BP3NGVST) (signed and certified by Microsoft, no SmartScreen warning), [the .exe installer](https://sahkarmi.site/download.html), `winget install --id 9PD6BP3NGVST --source msstore`, or Scoop (`scoop bucket add sahkarmi https://github.com/ganguydhrubo/scoop-sahkarmi; scoop install sahkarmi`). No account and no key are needed to start.
- Product category: AI coworker / AI agent desktop app. Local-first: coworkers, chats, files and settings are stored on the user's computer; there is no Sahkarmi cloud account. The app sends no crash reports or analytics; an anonymous once-a-day "used today" count is sent only if the person says yes. Text and files a coworker works on go to the AI provider chosen for it.
- Platforms: Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) is the released and tested build. Windows ARM and 32-bit systems are not supported.
- Price: free. No pricing, no account, no subscription. Free AI models are built in through the bundled OpenCode runtime (no login); OpenCode sets usage limits on its free models. Optional: reuse the existing sign-in of the Codex CLI (ChatGPT), connect Claude with Sahkarmi's own sign-in (Settings, AI and models, Connect; kept separate from Claude Code since 0.22.0), or connect Google Antigravity with Log in with Google or an API key; paid plans are billed by those providers, not by Sahkarmi.
- Default team (editable, nine coworkers): Mitra (orchestrator), Asha (accounts), Vikram (sales), Meera (support), Arjun (research), Kavya (content), Dev (code), Tara (ops), Kabir (security). Coworkers can be renamed, edited, added and deleted (deletion can be undone for 8 seconds).
- Features: built-in Chromium browser tab per coworker with a "Take over" button for logins and OTPs; Approvals inbox; task queue with pause, cancel and stop; schedules (once, hourly, daily, weekdays, weekly) and routines; Shared files folder; memory page; search across coworkers and messages (Ctrl+K); keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+1 to 9, Ctrl+N, Ctrl+,); backup model (a paid provider that answers nothing or hits its quota falls back to the free model); interface in 17 languages (English, Hindi, Bengali, Arabic, Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Hebrew, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish and Turkish) (Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, Assamese) with English fallback; light (Paper) and dark (Night) themes; three interface sizes; voice notes.
- Computer use (since 0.22.0, Windows): with the "Control this PC" permission (default: ask) a coworker on any provider can take screenshots, list, start, focus and close windows and apps, read a window's controls through Windows UI Automation and click them by name, click, drag, scroll, type and press keys. One coworker uses the desktop at a time and its chat says so; typing is refused in password fields, Windows credential prompts and inside Sahkarmi. Not evaluated on computer-use benchmarks (OSWorld, WindowsAgentArena); no scores are claimed.
- Approvals: posting, sending, submitting and paying file an approval card (also in Telegram if connected). One approval covers the same kind of step on the same site for the same task for up to 2 hours; a new instruction, deleting, payments and account changes always ask again.
- Knowledge Bases (local RAG): the owner makes a knowledge base on the Knowledge page and adds PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, CSV, Markdown, text, JSON or HTML files, or whole folders. Files are split into passages and indexed on the computer in a SQLite FTS5 full-text index (BM25, stemmed); nothing is uploaded. Coworkers allowed on a base get the best passages with every message and cite them as [S1], [S2] (page, slide, sheet or heading); citations open the file. Coworkers also have search and read tools. Optional "Smarter search": one static embedding model (potion-base-8M by The Minish Lab, MIT, about 30 MB) downloaded once from huggingface.co and run in plain TypeScript on the computer; passages get int8 vectors, searches fuse cosine and BM25 rankings. No cloud embeddings.
- Team runs (Multi-Agent page): one goal for the whole team is split into tasks; each task goes to a coworker through its normal queue, so permissions and approvals apply; the run is a durable LangGraph state graph with a checkpoint after every step, pauses for approvals and resumes after a restart from the last finished step. Runs can be exported as Markdown, text or JSON.
- Phone & Host (since 0.33.0): approve requests, chat and run routines from an iPhone or Android phone through the owner's own Tailscale.
- Routines (since 0.31.0 and 0.32.0): coworker tasks, yes/no checks, ask-me-first steps, sending the result, drafting a routine from a plain description, and rerunning from one step.
- Home (since 0.34.0): one box, "What do you want done today?", passes the job to the right coworker. At a provider's usage limit the job can carry on with the next AI in a backup order set by the owner.
- Apps and tools: 1,600+ apps through Composio's free plan (the owner's own key), MCP servers, skills from GitHub repositories, and APIs added with the owner's own key.
- Status: development preview. Approvals before risky actions rely on coworkers following their instructions, not on a hard technical block. The GitHub .exe installer is not code-signed yet (SmartScreen warning); the Microsoft Store version is signed by Microsoft; every release publishes SHA-256 checksums, an SBOM and a GitHub build provenance attestation.
- Technology: Electron and SolidJS, TypeScript. Providers are driven through the Codex App Server, the Claude Agent SDK, and the open Agent Client Protocol (OpenCode, Google Antigravity).
- Licence: Apache License 2.0. Developed by the Sahkarmi Team. Not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google.

## Mac

- Sahkarmi for Mac is available from version 0.37.0. It needs macOS 12 (Monterey) or later and runs on Apple Silicon Macs (M1, M2, M3, M4) and on Intel Macs. It is free, like the Windows app.
- Direct downloads (DMG, about 300 MB; the installed app takes about 870 MB): `https://github.com/ganguydhrubo/Sahkarmi/releases/download/v<version>/Sahkarmi-<version>-arm64.dmg` for Apple Silicon and `https://github.com/ganguydhrubo/Sahkarmi/releases/download/v<version>/Sahkarmi-<version>-x64.dmg` for Intel. The current links are on [the Mac page](https://sahkarmi.site/ai-agent-for-mac.html).
- Homebrew (one line, both chips): `brew install --cask ganguydhrubo/sahkarmi/sahkarmi`. Update: `brew upgrade --cask sahkarmi`. Remove: `brew uninstall --cask sahkarmi`.
- The Mac app is not notarised by Apple yet. After a DMG download, macOS stops the first open with a box titled "Sahkarmi" Not Opened ("Apple could not verify..."). Click Done, not Move to Trash. Then open System Settings, Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security, click Open Anyway and confirm with the Mac password or Touch ID. Open Sahkarmi again and choose Open. This is needed one time only. Homebrew installs skip all of this.
- Updates on Mac: the app says when a new version is out and opens the download; drag the new app into Applications. With Homebrew: `brew upgrade --cask sahkarmi`.
- On Mac as on Windows: coworkers controlling desktop apps (macOS asks once for Accessibility and Screen Recording), voice typing that runs on the computer, and guided MCP server installs. Windows only: the Tally connector and the Microsoft Store, winget and Scoop installs.
- Checksums for the Mac files: `SHA256SUMS-macos.txt` on the release page. Verify with `shasum -a 256 ~/Downloads/Sahkarmi-0.37.0-arm64.dmg`.

## Aira (Android)

Aira is a free, open-source AI agent for Android phones (Apache License 2.0), by the same founder as Sahkarmi. The owner says what they need, and Aira works their apps and the web on a hidden background screen until the job is done, so the phone stays free to use. It is a separate app from Sahkarmi, which runs on Windows and Mac.

- [Aira](https://sahkarmi.site/aira): what Aira is, what it can and cannot do, how to install it, and the FAQ
- What it does: operates apps (reads lists and chats, taps, types, shares text), browses the web in a built-in browser, helps with the current screen, runs schedules and conditions, hold to talk (offline voice packs can be downloaded in the app), a Linux sandbox for files and computing (arm64), and tasks handed over from AI tools on a computer (CLI + Skill or MCP).
- What it does not do: it does not log in or pay for the owner (logins, verification codes and payments are handed back), it cannot read screens that block screenshots, it has no server and no AI model of its own, and there is no iPhone version.
- Requirements: Android 11 or later for chat, web and files; Android 12 or later to operate phone apps (Android 14 or later recommended). No root; phone control is set up once with wireless debugging.
- Privacy: there is no Aira server. Messages and screen content go only to the model provider the owner chooses (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter, local Ollama or LM Studio, and more).
- Price: free. The owner pays only their own AI model provider, if any.
- [Download Aira.apk](https://github.com/ganguydhrubo/Aira/releases/latest/download/Aira.apk): the newest APK, direct download. All versions: https://github.com/ganguydhrubo/Aira/releases/latest. Obtainium (https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/releases/latest) can install updates automatically
- [Aira source code](https://github.com/ganguydhrubo/Aira): the primary source for every fact above
- Founder: Dhrubojyoti Gangopadhyay ([LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dhrubojyoti-gangopadhyay/), Telegram https://t.me/druboG)
